title: SciVerify-Digits: A Benchmark for Probing Multimodal Scientific Claim Verification

contributions.purpose: 提出诊断型多模态科学声明验证基准
contributions.mechanism: MNIST/Fashion-MNIST/SVHN 合成算术/计数/范围三类声明,程序化生成真值标签
contributions.evaluation: 可扩展合成基准(定性;规模未报样本数)
contributions.source_quote: We introduceSciVerify-Digits, a novel and extensible benchmark for diagnosing the reasoning capabilities of multimodal models in a scientific context.

contributions.purpose: 评测多类架构揭示系统性缺陷
contributions.mechanism: 简单拼接/交叉注意力/置换不变/多模态 LLM 四类模型对比
contributions.evaluation: M-LLM 零样本 MNIST 71.4/Fashion 68.5/SVHN 65.3/置换 SVHN 65.1(仅 Table 1 一行数值)
contributions.source_quote: We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of various architectures... revealing systemic weaknesses in generalization and robustness.

contributions.mechanism: 按声明类型拆解、注意力可视化、对抗鲁棒性评估
contributions.evaluation: 对抗声明下准确率骤降至近随机(定性)
contributions.source_quote: We provide a deep failure analysis, breaking down performance by claim type, visualizing attention maps to interpret model behavior, and assessing adversarial robustness.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work is inspired by diagnostic datasets designed to probe specific model capabilities. For example, CLEVR (Johnson et al., 2017) tests compositional reasoning... SciVerify-Digits fills this niche by creating tasks that require explicit arithmetic and logical operations grounded in visual data.
This work reframes the challenge from a simple negative result into a constructive diagnostic tool.

notes: 强红旗:与 AS0201 疑似同作者孪生/重复投稿——同一 MNIST 数据与结论,本文明说"把简单负结果重新包装为诊断工具"(reframes... from a simple negative result)。有三条自声明贡献列表。数据红旗:除 Table 1 一行 M-LLM 数值外无其他表格数据,其余靠图;无误差棒、无统计显著性、无计算资源(checklist 自认 No)。基准样本量未报。reject。
